prompt:
Edit this image into a clean, text-free photographic plate of the same scene: a monumental dark lobby wall of black stone with thin bronze-lit vertical louvres at both sides, a tall glass-and-bronze lift shaft in the centre glowing warm amber-orange from top to bottom, a polished stone floor with warm reflections, two potted plants, and at the bottom of the shaft the lift doors standing open onto a bright sunrise over misty mountains.
1. Remove every web-page overlay and fill with the wall behind it: the large vertical Japanese heading on the left, the thin orange vertical line and its dot, all Japanese paragraphs, the orange link and its arrow and underline, all numbers 01–06, all Japanese step names, the small outlined tag boxes and their text, the orange check marks, and the thin grey or orange horizontal indicator lines that run from the shaft outwards, with their round end dots — including the glowing orange line at the lowest landing.
2. Keep the whole shaft lit, the open doors and the sunrise exactly as they are.
Keep everything else exactly where it is — the same framing and perspective, the shaft's position and width, every landing slab at the same height, the walls, louvres, floor, plants and light. Redraw the photographic detail sharply at full resolution.
No text, letters, numbers, logos, lines, dots, icons or UI of any kind. No people. Landscape 3:2, the same size as the input.

attempts.result: Technically usable landscape image; no retry.

observations: Inspected generated original at full size using view_image with detail original.
No visible Japanese text, letters, numbers, logos, tag boxes, check marks, arrows, underlines, or other recognizable web UI.
No visible round endpoint dots or grey/orange overlay indicators extending across the right wall.

Visible lines remain in stone panel seams, vertical louvres, shaft framing, glass railings, landing edges, floor joints and amber lighting strips. A faint bronze angular outline remains on the wall immediately left of the shaft, beginning around mid-height and extending downward.
Small bright point-like architectural lights and highlights remain within the shaft.
Amber-lit shaft, open doorway with mountain sunrise, two potted plants, dark walls and reflective floor remain visible.
